$comment: FR-MSG-04 (PROJECT.md §2.15, §9 OpenObserve alerts as code). OpenObserve v2 alert definitions (POST /api/v2/{org}/alerts), format checked against OpenObserve v1.1.2. Destination 'aegispulse-ntfy' is created per environment and posts to that environment's ntfy topic (prod aegispulse-alerts, dev aegispulse-alerts-dev); N-04 wording: '{count} dead letters on {queue} in {window}'. Local equivalent: make check-dlq-alert.

alerts.name: aegispulse-dlq-spike
alerts.description: N-04 Dead-letter spike: more than 10 dead letters recorded by the events registry in 5 min (all queues). Runbook: docs/runbooks/dlq.md

alerts.name: aegispulse-dlq-depth
alerts.description: N-04 Dead letters waiting: a *.dlq queue has had messages ready for 10 min. Needs RabbitMQ per-object metrics (rabbitmq_prometheus, prometheus.return_per_object_metrics = true) shipped to OpenObserve. Runbook: docs/runbooks/dlq.md
